descriptionHtml:
ArtXplore, a creative poster competition, was organized by the IEEE Women in Engineering Student Branch Affinity Group of the University of Peradeniya in collaboration with the IEEE Women in Engineering Student Branch Affinity Group of Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka. ArtXplore is a project under WIE Connect of IEEE WIE Sri Lanka section. This visionary project aimed to ignite creativity and celebrate it through captivating posters. The competition aimed to promote creativity, encourage artistic expression, foster skill development, provide a platform for individuals to convey ideas visually, illuminate the remarkable contributions of women in STEM, raise awareness among the young generation, and empower young minds to explore boundless possibilities. The competition was conducted in two categories: schools and universities.

The competition concluded successfully after the award ceremony. Finally, special thanks goes to the esteemed judging panel members, Dr. Hiruni Rupasinghe and Mr. Amaresh Perera, whose expertise and discernment played a pivotal role in selecting our deserving winners.
